title: pogostemon sublanceolatus
intro: Pogostemon sublanceolatus, commonly known as Patchouli, is a perennial herb native to Southeast Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to aid in skin healing, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Patchouli include its anti-anxiety and anti-depressive effects, which can help alleviate stress and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Pogostemon sublanceolatus include patchoulol, pogostone, and sesquiterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
